description: This file defines a custom exception class `S3MultipartUploadException` within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling errors related to multipart uploads to S3. The class extends a general `MultipartUploadException` and adds methods to retrieve bucket, key, and filename information associated with the upload error.

classes.name: S3MultipartUploadException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for handling errors during S3 multipart uploads, providing access to the bucket, key, and source filename involved in the error.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception, optionally extracting bucket, key, and filename information from the previous exception or command object.

methods.name: getBucket
methods.description: Returns the bucket name associated with the multipart upload error.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the object key associated with the multipart upload error.

methods.name: getSourceFileName
methods.description: Returns the source filename associated with the upload, if available.

methods.name: collectPathInfo
methods.description: Internal method that extracts bucket, key, and filename information from a command object to store in the exception.
